scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n web,api,ai -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @completeit/web" "npm run dev -w @completeit/api" "npm run dev -w @completeit/ai"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @completeit/contracts && npm run build -w @completeit/web && npm run build -w @completeit/api
scripts.ai:setup: python3 -m venv services/ai/.venv && services/ai/.venv/bin/pip install -r services/ai/requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && npm run ai:setup && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
